names.summary: A 97-byte beacon with a large u4 counter, a GNSS block (ECEF position and velocity, 'no fix' frames read as -1), and a smooth u2 value that steps with sunlight, probably a battery voltage. The frame is mostly navigation data and is not a full housekeeping frame.

fields.name: uptime_counter
fields.rationale: Monotonic u4 that increases in 99.9% of frames with no resets. It rises about 194 counts/s, so it is not a plain ms or s clock. It could be a packet or tick counter. The unit is uncertain.

fields.name: gnss_pos_ecef_x
fields.rationale: Matches ECEF x from the TLE in 100% of fix frames at about 1e5 raw per km, which means centimetres. Other frames read -1 for no fix.

fields.name: gnss_pos_ecef_y
fields.rationale: Matches ECEF y at about 1e5 raw per km (cm), and moves with the x velocity as expected.

fields.name: gnss_pos_z
fields.rationale: Matches the z coordinate in 99.4% of fix frames at about 1e5 raw per km (cm). The z component is the same in ECI and ECEF, so the frame is ambiguous.

fields.name: gnss_vel_ecef_x
fields.rationale: Matches ECEF x velocity at about 1e5 raw per km/s, which means cm/s.

fields.name: gnss_vel_ecef_y
fields.rationale: The fit is flagged as matching, but the scale of 2.56e7 raw per km/s is implausible and the offset is odd (51, not 50). The field is probably misaligned and the real y velocity is likely at offset 50 or in a neighbouring field. Treat with caution.

fields.name: gnss_vel_z
fields.rationale: s3be at about 1e5 raw per km/s (cm/s) matches the z velocity in all fix frames. The frame (ECI or ECEF) is not determined.

fields.name: battery_voltage
fields.rationale: Smooth and narrow (spread 2%), in sun about 8294 versus 8158 in shadow, ratio 0.983. It falls in shadow (trend -0.64) and correlates with sun history (lag 5 min, rho 0.86). The 8.1-8.3k range fits a 2S Li-ion pack in mV.

names.health: Not much to go on in 16 days. The counter shows no resets, so there are no reboots. The battery voltage follows the sun-shadow cycle, with a daily low and high that do not drift, so there is no evidence of ageing. Thermal fields are not present.

names.summary: A 214-byte housekeeping/telemetry beacon with a GNSS position/velocity block (offsets 34-58), a block of sun-driven power values (offsets 59-87) and a block of temperature-like signed bytes (offsets 162-174), plus counters. All frames show an eclipse in the preceding 80 min, so lagged fields are real thermal or charge responses.

fields.name: uptime_or_timestamp_seconds
fields.rationale: u4be monotonic counter with 0 resets, rate 0.00296 per second, which is slow and not a seconds clock. Probably a coarse tick or sequence counter; it moves with offset 160.

fields.name: frame_sequence_counter
fields.rationale: u2be counter rising 4.27/s with 18 wraps in the window and a roll-over by design. Likely a packet or sample counter.

fields.name: gnss_pos_ecef_x
fields.rationale: All matching frames agree with ECEF X (raw_per_km about 1e5), so centimetres. Value -1 means no fix.

fields.name: gnss_pos_ecef_y
fields.rationale: Matches ECEF Y at about 1e5 raw per km, so centimetres; -1 is the no-fix value.

fields.name: gnss_pos_z
fields.rationale: Matches the Z coordinate at about 1e5 raw per km (labelled ECI by the engine, but Z is the same in ECEF and ECI up to a small effect). Centimetres.

fields.name: gnss_vel_ecef_x
fields.rationale: ECEF X velocity with about 1e5 raw per km/s, so cm/s.

fields.name: gnss_vel_ecef_y
fields.scale: raw / 25606.4 (km/s scale 2.56e7 raw per km/s, doubtful)
fields.rationale: Matches 98% of frames but the scale of 2.56e7 per km/s is odd, and the offset may be misaligned. It probably is ECEF Y velocity in cm/s at an unaligned position, so low confidence.

fields.name: gnss_vel_z
fields.rationale: s3be field matching the Z velocity at 1e5 raw per km/s, so cm/s.

fields.name: battery_or_bus_voltage_raw
fields.rationale: Narrow range (relative spread 0.02), higher in sun (8293 vs 8157), and falling in shadow; consistent with a 2-cell battery voltage at 8.1-8.3 V.

fields.name: solar_input_count_small
fields.rationale: Near 1 in shadow and up to 24 in sun, correlated with the solar current block. Maybe a panel or channel count or a low-resolution current.

fields.name: solar_or_load_current_adc
fields.rationale: Rough, sun mean 133 vs shadow 51, partially tied to sunlight; weaker evidence.

fields.name: solar_array_current_total
fields.rationale: Plateau of about 4500 in sun and about 320 in shadow, a typical solar input current.

fields.name: solar_current_panel_a
fields.rationale: About 1900 in sun and 303 in shadow with a floor offset; behaves as a current set by illumination.

fields.name: solar_current_panel_b
fields.rationale: Rough, near 1 in shadow and about 290 in sun, a current from a panel.

fields.name: solar_current_panel_c
fields.rationale: Floor of 5 in shadow and about 330 in sun; groups with the other panel currents.

fields.name: solar_current_panel_d
fields.rationale: Floor of 8 in shadow, rising through sunlight (37 to 118) and grouping with the other panel currents.

fields.name: uptime_seconds_counter
fields.rationale: u2be monotonic counter with 0 resets, rate 0.01667 per second, about 1 count per minute. It looks like an uptime in minutes.

fields.name: temp_panel_1
fields.rationale: Signed byte in -17..23, lagged sun response with tau 20 min, trend positive in sun and negative in shadow, and it moves with 164 and 166.

fields.name: temp_panel_2
fields.rationale: Signed byte, a larger swing from -13 to 33, and a strong sun response with thermal-like trends; it groups with the other temperatures.

fields.name: temp_panel_3
fields.rationale: Lagged correlation 0.98 at tau 20 min, signed degC range, consistent trends in sun and shadow.

fields.name: temp_internal_1
fields.rationale: Orbit-periodic with a narrow range, warmer in shadow than in sun, so likely an internal or heated component. It moves with the 167-174 group.

fields.name: temp_panel_4
fields.rationale: Lagged correlation 0.985 at tau 20 min, same behaviour as 162 and 164.

fields.name: temp_internal_2
fields.rationale: u1 orbit-periodic, warmer in shadow with the opposite phase to the panel temperatures; a heated or internal sensor group.

fields.name: temp_internal_3
fields.rationale: Same behaviour as 167, with a strongly negative trend in shadow.

fields.name: temp_internal_4
fields.rationale: Anti-correlated with sun and orbit-periodic like the group.

fields.name: temp_internal_5
fields.rationale: Same group, falls during shadow and rises in sun, with a negative lag correlation.

fields.name: temp_internal_6
fields.rationale: Same group of related sensors.

fields.name: temp_internal_7
fields.rationale: Same group, same response profile.

fields.name: temp_internal_8
fields.rationale: Same group, same response profile.

fields.name: temp_internal_9
fields.rationale: Same group, same response profile.

names.health: No reboots are visible: the two slow counters at 27 and 160 never reset in the 15.8-day window. The temperatures swing with the lag expected of thermal inertia, and the voltage-like field at 59 follows sun and shadow. A mildly falling daily low in that field (about -15 raw per 30 days) is weak evidence of ageing over a short window, so overall health looks nominal with low confidence.
